definitions.gloss: to jump, to leap, to hop
definitions.explanation: To spring up from the ground or a surface.
For something to spring back or splatter.

examples.japanese: {兎|うさぎ}が{ぴょんぴょん}{跳|は}ねている。
{油|あぶら}が{跳|は}ねて{火傷|やけど}をした。
examples.english: The oil splattered and I got burned.

examples.japanese: ボールが{跳|は}ねて{取|と}りにくかった。
examples.english: The ball bounced and was hard to catch.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Transitive pair: {跳|は}ねる can also be used transitively in some contexts. Pattern: Xが{跳|は}ねる (X jumps/bounces).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {跳|は}ねている = 'is jumping/bouncing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {ぴょんぴょん}{跳|は}ねる (to hop around)
- {油|あぶら}が{跳|は}ねる (oil splatters)
- {水|みず}が{跳|は}ねる (water splashes)
- {髪|かみ}が{跳|は}ねる (hair sticks out)

HOMOPHONE:
- {撥|は}ねる - to reject, hit (different kanji)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {跳|と}ぶ - to jump (higher, more distance)
- {弾|は}む - to bounce, spring back
